paper_data.common_inputs: Identical original paper, scientific observations, qualified training labels, frozen task specification and source-matched validation feedback, only after protected manifests are bound.

paper_data_author_code.common_inputs: Exactly the same original scientific inputs, support, metric, target boundary and cumulative budgets as paper_data.
paper_data_author_code.additional_information: Only explicit authenticated original author-code members and qualified dependency closure. No reference predictions, saved models/weights, coefficients or private evaluator outputs.

source_data_evidence.selection: All ten original Figure 5 neural/kinematic sessions and source RADICaL inputs

source_exposure: Both conditions share original scientific inputs and source preprocessing exposure. Only source-permitted training/validation feedback may be visible; protect final per-fit outcomes, reference predictions and fitted parameters. If preserving source preprocessing conflicts with a proposed target boundary, resolve it before delivery rather than silently alter the original task. Author code is the sole added information in paper_data_author_code; no new access or execution authority is granted.
protected_material: Original final held-out outcomes and source/reference prediction/probability/metric bodies.
Source saved fitted models, coefficients and private evaluation policies/output artifacts.
Any label-bearing workspace, notebook output or metadata enabling reconstruction of protected final targets.
evaluation_boundary: Freeze candidate code before operator-only original-fit execution; preserve source-allowed training/validation and preprocessing exposure. Independently join private original outcomes and derive complete source metrics. Exact source-compatible delivery/verification boundaries remain unresolved; this is not a grant of data access.
knowledge_limit: Published paper claims may be intentionally visible, but copying them is not computed reproduction. The no-code arm must not acquire author source or local reference recipes indirectly. Source-code package and dependency audits remain unresolved.
required_before_activation: Authenticate all ten original session inputs, RADICaL rates, eligible trial order, date/area joins, ZETA selection and pre-CV PCA exposure.
Recover original 50-fit trial manifests and shared-RNG/source configuration ordering; seed 240926 alone does not reconstruct publication folds.
Recover complete published/source-author VE and prediction references and independently qualify original MATLAB/dependency/runtime parity; no numeric author baseline is established.

Resolve the strongest relevant original-author comparator under the same instantaneous observation scope. Keep main ridge/RADICaL, bagged reconstruction, lagged and partial/residual branches distinct; a local phase template is not the paper method.
Authenticate granular trajectory/posture/control/scatter provenance and source display selections; reconcile the supplement-3 caption/source left-right ordering discrepancy.

Justify numerical reproduction tolerance and meaningful complete-family improvement/uncertainty under five paired mice and dependent joints/folds; no arbitrary scalar, any-positive-delta or significance-maximization rule.

Bind protected source-compatible per-fit execution, common scientific input/exposure and official-code allowlists, independent verification and cumulative budgets. Existing scorer/exporter code is not an admitted end-to-end runtime.

Existing improvement/v1 admits one scalar candidate/published value. This vector endpoint requires future full-panel comparison/admission support; no global mean or win count is invented. Central versioned-directory adoption remains pending.
